name: Probucol

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States, first in 1995 — for effects on the body's chemistry and heart harm

summary: Probucol was removed from the United States market beginning in 1995 due to harmful effects on the heart and changes in body chemistry [3]. A small computer model, not tests on actual people, gave the drug a low score of 27 for liver risk [M]. This same computer model also gave the medication a low score of 13 for heart risk [M].
